description: SwiftUI iOS prayer-lock alarm named Miqat that compiles on iPhone 17 Pro sim and looks like a chapel, not Clock.app.

userStories.title: Xcode project builds
userStories.description: Do NOT emit Miqat.xcodeproj or any .pbxproj — the harness generates the project with xcodegen from project.yml. Emit EXACTLY these four files, one or two per iteration, each complete: (1) project.yml — a minimal XcodeGen spec: name Miqat, one iOS app target Miqat, deploymentTarget iOS 26.0, sources [Miqat], bundle id com.ashen.miqat, generate an Info.plist automatically via settings. (2) Miqat/MiqatApp.swift — @main SwiftUI App showing HomeView. (3) Miqat/ChapelTheme.swift — the sacred chapel design tokens (deep night blues, candle gold, Song-geometry accents per the brief). (4) Miqat/HomeView.swift — compilable chapel home placeholder using ChapelTheme. Every referenced type must exist.

userStories.title: Create an alarm
userStories.description: User can add time, repeat days, label, prayer pack (1-4 rakaat), recitation toggle, seal pack toggle. Editor compiles and is reachable from home. SwiftData or equivalent persistence on device only. EMISSION RULES: AlarmModels.swift is already on disk and good — do not re-emit it. Emit ONE file per iteration. AlarmEditorView.swift keeps truncating — keep it under 170 lines: extract row/subviews into computed properties, cut comments, no previews. Files go under Miqat/ — never at repo root.
